milestones.title: MCP Server Implementation
milestones.description: Create the main MCP server with stdio transport and tool handlers.

tasks.title: Implement MCP Server Entry Point
tasks.description: Create the main MCP server with stdio transport.

subtasks.title: Create MCP server initialization
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: Per plan/architecture/external_deps.md, use Server from @modelcontextprotocol/sdk with StdioServerTransport.
2. INPUT: executeMdsel from P2.M1.T1.S1.
3. LOGIC: Create src/index.ts. Import Server, StdioServerTransport from MCP SDK. Create server with name 'mdsel-mcp', version '1.0.0', capabilities: {tools: {}}. Create transport and connect. Handle process signals for graceful shutdown.
4. OUTPUT: /src/index.ts with server initialization.

subtasks.title: Implement tools list handler
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: Per plan/architecture/tool_schemas.md, expose exactly two tools: mdsel.index and mdsel.select.
2. INPUT: Server from P2.M2.T1.S1.
3. LOGIC: Register ListToolsRequestSchema handler. Return tools array with: 1) mdsel.index - description from tool_schemas.md, inputSchema {type: object, properties: {files: {type: array, items: {type: string}}}, required: ['files']}. 2) mdsel.select - description from tool_schemas.md, inputSchema {type: object, properties: {selector: {type: string}, files: {type: array, items: {type: string}}}, required: ['selector', 'files']}.
4. OUTPUT: Updated /src/index.ts with ListTools handler.

tasks.title: Implement Tool Handlers
tasks.description: Implement the execution handlers for mdsel.index and mdsel.select.

subtasks.title: Implement mdsel.index handler
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: Per PRD, output must be byte-for-byte identical to mdsel CLI output. Per plan/architecture/tool_schemas.md, CLI mapping is: mdsel index --json <files...>.
2. INPUT: ListTools handler from P2.M2.T1.S2, executeMdsel from P2.M1.T1.S1.
3. LOGIC: In CallToolRequestSchema handler, if name === 'mdsel.index': extract files from arguments. Call executeMdsel(['index', '--json', ...files]). If exitCode === 0, return {content: [{type: 'text', text: stdout}]}. If exitCode !== 0, return {isError: true, content: [{type: 'text', text: stdout || stderr}]}.
4. OUTPUT: Updated /src/index.ts with mdsel.index handler.

subtasks.title: Implement mdsel.select handler
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: Per PRD, output must be byte-for-byte identical to mdsel CLI output. Per plan/architecture/tool_schemas.md, CLI mapping is: mdsel select --json <selector> <files...>.
2. INPUT: mdsel.index handler from P2.M2.T2.S1.
3. LOGIC: In CallToolRequestSchema handler, if name === 'mdsel.select': extract selector and files from arguments. Call executeMdsel(['select', '--json', selector, ...files]). Return stdout as text content, or error with isError: true if exitCode !== 0.
4. OUTPUT: Updated /src/index.ts with mdsel.select handler.

subtasks.title: Implement unknown tool error handling
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: MCP protocol requires error response for unknown tool names.
2. INPUT: Tool handlers from P2.M2.T2.S1-S2.
3. LOGIC: In CallToolRequestSchema handler, add default case for unknown tool names. Return {isError: true, content: [{type: 'text', text: 'Unknown tool: <name>'}]}.
4. OUTPUT: Updated /src/index.ts with complete error handling.
